_nota: English dictionary for the i18n infrastructure (i18next + react-i18next). Mirrors the same key tree as es-ES.json. Covers navigation, login and the Ajustes tab of Yo for now; the rest of the app still has fixed Spanish text and can be migrated to this system progressively.

login.subtitulo: Training, nutrition and shopping cost, all in one place.
login.privacidad: Connects to your own server. Your data never leaves your network.

ejercicios.mostrarMediaHint: Turn it off for a simpler training screen.

datos.descripcion: Download a copy of your profile and weight goal as a JSON file.

idioma.hint: Changes the language of the navigation, sign-in screen and these settings. The rest of the app will be translated progressively.
